home.lead: Turn conversations into searchable notes. Review recordings and ask your chosen AI for the next step.
home.available: Free to install on Mac, iPhone and iPad, with a companion Apple Watch app. Optional Pro features unlock with a one-time App Store purchase.
home.line1: Can we lock next week’s schedule? Budget stays at the last tier.
home.line2: Yes. I’ll narrow it to what we can ship in two weeks.
home.line3: Yes. I’ll send a two-week scope this afternoon, locked to last time’s budget.
home.factFreeV: Basic recording, saved notes and normal playback
home.factTrialV: iOS offers one optional 7-day Pro trial. Mac offers 20 shared API trial uses.
home.factPayV: One-time App Store purchase. See your storefront for the price.
home.whatBody: Dictation Notes is a personal meeting notebook and reply cue. While you stay in the room, the other person’s words become text, and you can ask for a short line you can actually say. You bring your own speech and AI keys. We do not run a backend, and we do not ship developer keys.
home.notBody: User-started iPhone and Watch audio recordings can continue in the background or with the screen locked. Stop and save to finish. Live dictation stops when you leave its screen. On Mac, start and stop from the window, menu bar or Option-Shift-D. Command-Shift-P pauses or resumes. Quitting stops capture. Obtain any required recording consent.
home.useMeetB: Talk and watch the transcript at the same time. History and recordings stay on this device by default.
home.useTalkB: Set a goal, background, and speaking style for this session, then ask for a reply, a summary, a critique, or a short forecast.
home.useLangB: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, and Indonesian.
home.localBody: Free dictation needs no API key. Apple speech recognition may process audio on the device or send it to Apple when local recognition is unavailable. Cloud transcription and AI send data directly to the provider you select and authorize. We do not run a backend receiving your recordings or transcripts.
home.byokBody: The app ships with no developer API keys and does not proxy requests. Whoever you pick sends the bill. You can also point it at your own compatible chat completions endpoint.
home.howLead: Record, review the source, then keep or share the notes you need.
home.howListenB: Allow the microphone. On-device dictation needs no key. Add a speech provider you trust only if you want cloud transcription.
home.howAskB: Use the four Mac shortcuts for a reply, a concept explanation, key takeaways or action items. AI requests go to the provider you configure and authorize.
home.howKeepB: History and recordings stay on the device unless you export or share them. We have nowhere to receive them.
home.priceLead: The app is free to install. The unlock is a non-consumable one-time purchase. Family Sharing is on. Restore with the same Apple ID on iPhone and Mac.

privacy.p1: Dictation Notes provides transcription and AI tools on Mac, iPhone and iPad. Apple Watch records audio for transfer to the paired iPhone. The publisher operates no application content backend. Apple and your chosen providers may process data. Support email handling is described below.
privacy.pWho: The app is published on the App Store by Shanghai Qishan Cultural Communication Co., Ltd. Copyright is marked © 2026 Zhichao Wei. Privacy questions: 281916057@qq.com.
privacy.pCollect: There is no developer server receiving accounts, analytics events, advertising IDs, or crash dossiers. The app does not embed a tracking SDK and does not track across apps.
privacy.pLocal: Recordings, transcripts, titles, marked moments, local notes and generated results are stored on your device. API credentials use the system Keychain. Mac can use a selected library folder or external drive. Migration copies and verifies the library and retains its original. Mac audio is retained when Save recordings is enabled. Exports and operating-system backups may create copies at destinations governed by your settings.
privacy.pProviders: With your permission, cloud transcription sends audio to your chosen speech provider. AI replies, translation and summaries send transcripts, questions, recent conversation history and any background you enter to your chosen AI provider. On Mac, consent identifies the provider and endpoint; changing the recipient requires new consent. Connection tests for cloud or remote services follow recipient consent controls; a loopback AI model running on this Mac does not require cloud sending consent. AI tests send a fixed prompt and cloud transcription tests send synthetic silence, without private notes or microphone content. Providers may charge for tests. A model running on this Mac receives text locally; a LAN or remote endpoint receives it off this Mac.
privacy.pRecord: Recordings and transcripts may contain sensitive conversation. Use recording, transcription, or summaries only where legal and with any required consent. The app repeats this notice before the first listening session.
privacy.pPurchase: The lifetime unlock is processed by Apple through the App Store. We do not receive or store payment card information. Apple may process purchase receipts under its own privacy policy. This is a non-consumable one-time purchase, not an auto-renewing subscription.
privacy.pStore: The App Store label includes optional cloud-provider collection of audio, other user content, user IDs, usage, diagnostic and network data. Data may be linked to your provider account. The developer does not receive audio, transcripts, AI prompts or payment card details.
privacy.pSite: This static site is hosted on GitHub Pages. We use no analytics, advertising, tracking SDKs or language-preference storage. Fonts and screenshots are served with the site. GitHub may process IP addresses and ordinary access logs under its privacy policy. Visiting App Store or provider links is subject to the destination's policy.
privacy.pRights: You can delete sessions, recordings and keys in the app. On Mac, revoke data sharing consent in Settings to cancel connection tests, cloud transcription and AI requests, turn off automatic suggestions and translation, and stop capture. A single recording deletion can be undone during the same app run while its file remains in Trash; deleting a whole session has no equivalent full-note undo. Removing the app alone may leave data and Keychain credentials. Clear history and keys if you want to remove them, and separately manage old libraries, exports, shared files and backups.
privacy.pChildren: The app is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children.
privacy.pChange: We update the date and publish revised information when this policy changes. This update covers selected AI text and sources, Watch recording transfers, backups and platform-specific access rules. The app requests required sending consent.
privacy.pContact: For privacy questions write to 281916057@qq.com and include device, OS version, and app version. Do not paste API keys or raw recordings in email.

support.startBody: Install from the App Store, allow the microphone and speech recognition, then tap Start. On-device dictation stays free and does not count toward the trial. Add your own key in Settings later if you want cloud transcription or AI replies, then save and test.
support.a1: Allow the microphone first. On-device dictation also needs speech recognition permission. Turn both on in system Settings, then tap Start again. Some languages may use Apple speech recognition if an offline model is missing, and that path needs a network.
support.q2: How to connect your own API
support.a2: On Mac, open Settings, choose an AI or transcription provider, enter the required credentials and select Save configuration. Then select Test connection and follow any prompt to authorize the recipient. A loopback AI model running on this Mac does not need cloud sending consent. AI tests send a fixed connectivity prompt; cloud transcription tests send one second of synthetic silence. They do not use private notes or microphone audio, but provider charges may apply. iPhone has its own provider setup controls. Free Apple Speech dictation needs no transcription key.

support.a5: Check the credentials, model availability, endpoint and network. For a local or LAN model, confirm the service is running at that address. If saving the key fails on Mac, unlock Keychain and enter and save the key again. Do not delete existing Keychain items or email the full key.

privacy.pApple: On Mac, free dictation prefers recognition on the device. iPhone may use on-device recognition or Apple speech services. If a Mac offline model is unavailable or fails, audio may also be sent to Apple speech services. Apple processes received audio under its privacy policy. The app explains possible Apple processing before listening and requests system speech recognition permission. Microphone and optional Mac system audio capture also require system permission.
privacy.pCloudData: Cloud providers may retain audio and other user content after a request, together with API account identifiers, request times and counts, token usage, error/trace logs and network information such as IP addresses. These may be linked to your provider account. They support authentication, transcription, AI features, security and service operations. Some providers also analyze usage or use submitted content to improve or train models under their own terms and account settings. The app does not send advertising identifiers or use these requests for advertising tracking.
privacy.pRetention: Retention, model training and international processing depend on the provider, endpoint, plan and account settings. We do not promise universal zero retention or no training. Check the linked current provider policies before sending sensitive content. Local deletion or revoking permission stops future sending but does not erase data already received by a provider; request deletion from that provider.

home.macBullet3: See save status and retry failed saves. Choose a library folder; migration copies and verifies data while keeping the original.

home.faq5q: Do Mac and iPhone automatically sync history?
home.faq5a: Mac, iPhone and iPad keep their own note libraries and API settings. Restoring a purchase restores access to the features. Watch recordings are transferred to the paired iPhone. Use export or sharing to move other notes between devices.
home.faq6a: No. Apple Speech prefers on-device recognition on Mac, but may send audio to Apple if an offline model is unavailable or fails. iPhone may also use Apple speech services. Offline availability depends on the language, model and system.
support.q9: How do I capture meeting audio on Mac?
support.a9: In Mac Settings, select system audio or mixed input. Allow screen and system audio recording in macOS Privacy & Security, then restart the app if macOS asks. Mixed input also needs microphone permission. The app uses ScreenCaptureKit for audio and does not save screen video. Use capture only with any required participant consent.
support.q10: How do I replay or export a recording?
support.a10: Open a saved Mac session and select its recording. Playback includes a draggable playhead, 15-second skips and 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5 or 2× speed. Export transcript text, Markdown, meeting notes, individual audio or a session folder with its saved audio. Command-Shift-E exports Markdown. Missing audio prevents a complete session export; a transcript cannot recreate audio that was never saved.
support.q11: How do I delete a Mac recording and undo it?
support.a11: Stop listening, then use the recording trash button. The audio moves to the Mac Trash; text and notes remain. Command-Option-Z restores that single recording deletion during the same app run. Deleting a session or clearing history has no equivalent full-note undo. Bulk cleanup is irreversible; migrated originals, exports and backup copies must be managed separately.
support.q12: How do I stop sending data to a provider?
support.a12: In Mac Settings, open Account and Privacy, then revoke data sharing permission. The app cancels ongoing cloud and AI requests. Changing the recipient requires new permission. Data already received by Apple or a provider is governed by that service; contact it to request deletion.
support.q13: Can I import records from the older Mac app?
support.a13: In Mac Settings, choose Import legacy records and select the old data folder. Keep a backup before importing. Text and available recordings are imported; a missing original audio file cannot be recovered from a transcript. Use Show data in Finder to locate the current app's data rather than assuming an old folder path.
support.q14: Can I use an AI model running on my Mac?
support.a14: Run a compatible chat completions service and set its endpoint in AI Settings, for example a loopback address on this Mac. Text sent to a model genuinely running on this Mac stays local to that service; a LAN or remote endpoint sends it off this Mac. Apple speech processing is independent. Local models still use the app's AI trial and unlock rules.
privacy.pCapture: Mac can capture a microphone, system audio or mixed input. System capture requires the macOS screen and system audio recording permission. ScreenCaptureKit supplies audio to the chosen recognition path and, when enabled, a local M4A or WAV recording. The app does not save screen video. Audio may include other participants or sounds from other apps.
privacy.pSync: The app does not automatically synchronize Mac and iPhone history or recordings. Purchase restoration restores the unlock only. Exporting, sharing or an operating-system backup may create copies at your chosen destination; that destination or backup service has its own privacy policy. Deleting the original does not delete these copies.
privacy.pSupport: If you email support, we receive your email address, message and any diagnostics or attachments you choose to send. We use them to answer and investigate your request. You can contact 281916057@qq.com to request deletion, subject to applicable retention requirements. Do not include API keys, private recordings or sensitive transcripts.
home.updateBody: Choose notes for the new daily reviews and highlight collections, and preview the text before sending. Search opens matching source text. Select and fine-tune passages for summaries, action items, reply drafts or source-linked communication reviews. Improved recording details, playback controls, transcription completion and Watch recording reliability.
support.a15: On Mac 1.2.2, select Pause or press Command-Shift-P. The current segment finishes and recording time stops. Resume adds a new audio segment to the same note. Wait for final processing before continuing, or cancel the wait to keep text already received and audio already written; the final sentence may be incomplete. Save recordings must be enabled to retain audio.
support.q15: How do I pause and resume on Mac?
support.q16: What should I do if saving fails?
support.a16: Keep the Mac window open and preserve the unsaved text. Check free disk space, folder permissions and any external drive connection, then select Retry save or press Command-S. A failed save before switching notes keeps you on the current note. Do not clear history to troubleshoot. Unreturned recognition results and audio that was never saved cannot be recovered by retrying.
support.q17: How do I find a phrase in this transcript?
support.a17: On Mac, press Command-Option-F to find text within the current transcript. Command-F searches across saved sessions. You can edit transcript lines, then press Command-S to save. Search and local editing do not require an AI provider.
support.q18: How do I move or back up my Mac library?
support.a18: Stop listening and finish exports before choosing a storage folder in Settings. The app copies and verifies the library into Dictation Notes Data under the selected location, then switches to it; the original library stays in place. Reconnect an unavailable external drive. Use Show data in Finder to locate the active library. For a backup, stop and save, quit normally, then copy the entire library. A session-with-audio export covers that session only. Keep exported files and original libraries separately; the app does not sync them to iPhone.
support.q19: Where are the four Mac AI shortcuts?
support.a19: The assistant keeps four actions above the input: suggest a reply, explain a concept, extract key takeaways and organize action items. Add your goal or background as needed. Configure and authorize an AI provider first; a compatible model running on this Mac is also supported. AI uses share the 20-use trial and one-time unlock; provider fees are separate. Review generated results before relying on them.
privacy.pRecovery: Mac library migration retains the original library; legacy imports may also retain internal original files for recovery. Session-with-audio exports, shared files and backups create additional copies. Deletion in the app applies to the active library, not external migration originals, import sources or exported and backed-up copies. Clear all history also removes internal legacy originals. Manage other copies at their own destinations. A folder managed by a sync or backup service is subject to that service’s policies. Pausing stops capture and resuming creates a new segment. Canceling final processing preserves received text and written audio, but does not erase data already received by a provider or recover unsaved audio.
home.mobileBody: Turn meetings, lectures, interviews and spoken ideas into notes you can revisit. Dictation Notes brings together iPhone audio recording, live speech-to-text and optional AI meeting summaries.
home.mobileBullet1: Record on iPhone, pause and resume, then transcribe with Apple speech recognition.
home.mobileBullet2: Search results take you to the matching text. Replay nearby audio when timing data is available. Gather manually marked moments and add titles or local notes.
home.mobileBullet3: Select passages, adjust the text to send, then request a summary, action items, reply draft or communication review. Open linked sources to check the result. Verify AI interpretations yourself.
home.watchBody: With Pro, record on Apple Watch, mark key moments and transfer to your paired iPhone for review.
support.q20: How do I record, transcribe and replay on iPhone or iPad?
support.a20:
Record on iPhone, pause and resume, then transcribe with Apple speech recognition. Read a compact transcript preview or open the full text. Edit saved text and titles. With Pro, search titles and transcripts, and jump to marked moments or transcript timestamps. Use your chosen AI service for full-recording summaries, takeaways and action items. Open cited source text to check the result.

User-started iPhone and Watch audio recordings can continue in the background or with the screen locked. Stop and save to finish. Live dictation stops when you leave its screen.

With Pro, export original text, summaries, audio or a backup. Restoring an existing backup is free and merges records, skipping matching IDs and records marked deleted. Backups contain note content and available audio. API keys, purchase credentials and system settings are excluded.
support.q21: Why has my Watch recording not reached iPhone?
support.a21: Activate Pro on the paired iPhone and allow the Watch microphone. Check that Watch and iPhone are paired and connected, then open the iPhone app. Keep the original Watch recording while transfer is pending and use Retry if a transfer error appears. The received status appears after iPhone safely stores the recording. Receipt confirmation keeps the Watch original available.
support.q22: How do daily reviews and selected passages use my notes?
support.a22: Search results take you to the matching text. Replay nearby audio when timing data is available. Select notes by date for a daily review of highlights, decisions and action items. Preview the exact text and recipient before generation. Gather manually marked moments and add titles or local notes. Select passages, adjust the text to send, then request a summary, action items, reply draft or communication review. Open linked sources to check the result. Verify AI interpretations yourself.
privacy.hReview: Selected text and AI source links
privacy.pReview: Daily reviews send the text and titles of the notes you select by date to your chosen AI provider. Passage actions send the selected text after your adjustments and the context shown in the sending preview. Check the exact text and recipient before confirming. Results and links to the source passages are stored with their owning note. AI interpretations need your review. Opening a source link uses your local notes. Provider retention and deletion follow the provider policy below.
privacy.pWatch: Apple Watch stores source audio and marked moments locally and transfers them to the paired iPhone through WatchConnectivity. iPhone confirms receipt after saving. The original remains on Watch after that confirmation. Explicit cancellation or deletion can propagate to the paired device. Exports, backups and content already sent to a provider must be managed at their own destinations. Watch Pro access is activated on the paired iPhone.
